zh.title: 南韓空軍首架Embraer C-390運輸機飛抵首爾，預計12月正式交機
zh.summary: 南韓空軍採購的首架Embraer C-390 Millennium運輸機11月23日降落城南市的首爾空軍基地，機上仍掛巴西測試註冊號PT-ZNA，正式交機尚未進行；這是南韓購買的3架之一。
body: AeroTime與Aerospace Global News報導，Embraer為南韓空軍製造的首架C-390 Millennium運輸機，11月23日降落京畿道城南市的首爾空軍基地，結束從巴西出發、途經阿曼馬斯喀特、印度清奈與菲律賓克拉克的長程調機飛行。AeroTime指出，這架序號39000013的飛機已塗上南韓空軍標誌，但仍掛巴西測試註冊號PT-ZNA，尚未正式交付空軍。
Aerospace Global News報導，正式交機預計在12月進行，其餘兩架預計在2027年底前交付；截至報導時，南韓空軍與Embraer尚未對此發布消息。Embraer今年2月在新加坡航空展表示這架飛機已進入最後組裝階段，AeroTime則稱它今年3月在巴西加維昂佩肖托廠區完成首飛。
南韓防衛事業廳2023年12月4日選定C-390，擊敗洛克希德馬丁C-130J與空中巴士A400M，南韓也成為這款運輸機的首個亞洲客戶。依AeroTime引述，防衛事業廳當時表示計畫預算為7,100億韓元（當時約5.43億美元）。南韓空軍現役戰術運輸機包括2014年交付的4架C-130J-30，以及較舊的C-130H與CN-235螺旋槳運輸機。
Embraer稱雙渦扇發動機的C-390最大酬載26公噸、巡航速度每小時870公里。AeroTime指出，這款運輸機今年已交付捷克與烏茲別克首架，希臘也在11月2日簽約採購3架KC-390並保留3架選購權。

en.title: South Korea’s first Embraer C-390 Millennium airlifter arrives in Seoul ahead of handover
en.summary: The first Embraer C-390 Millennium built for the Republic of Korea Air Force landed at Seoul Air Base in Seongnam on November 23, still carrying the Brazilian test registration PT-ZNA ahead of a formal handover. It is the first of three South Korea is buying.
body: The first Embraer C-390 Millennium built for the Republic of Korea Air Force (ROKAF) landed at Seoul Air Base in Seongnam on November 23, AeroTime and Aerospace Global News reported, completing a long ferry flight from Brazil with stops in Muscat, Oman; Chennai, India; and Clark in the Philippines. AeroTime said the aircraft, serial number 39000013, wore ROKAF markings but still carried the Brazilian test registration PT-ZNA, and had not yet been formally delivered to the air force.

Aerospace Global News reported that the formal handover is expected in December and that the remaining two aircraft are due by the end of 2027, adding that neither the ROKAF nor Embraer had yet announced the milestone. Embraer said at the Singapore Airshow in February that the aircraft had reached the final stage of assembly, and AeroTime reported that it made its maiden flight at Embraer’s Gavião Peixoto facility in Brazil in March.

South Korea’s Defense Acquisition Program Administration (DAPA) selected the C-390 on December 4, 2023, over the Lockheed Martin C-130J and the Airbus A400M, making South Korea the first Asian customer for the type. According to AeroTime, DAPA valued the program at 710 billion won, about $543 million at the time. The ROKAF’s tactical transport fleet includes four C-130J-30s delivered in 2014, alongside older C-130H and CN-235 turboprops.

Embraer says the twin-turbofan C-390 can carry up to 26 metric tons of payload and cruise at 870 kilometers per hour. AeroTime noted that Embraer delivered the first aircraft for the Czech Republic and Uzbekistan this year, and that Greece signed for three KC-390s with options for three more on November 2.
